selection: current on any RGB distance>9, otherwise inclusive current+past mean

residual: signed source minus current guide prediction; frozen source-sigma soft spectral 4RMS / past-only3RMS innovation, currentDC
validation: 13 frozen alpha families, authenticated exact observed/reference/control regeneration
truth_use: fixture construction and scoring only; estimator accepts raw,diff,spec,controls
claims: CPU source-pilot feasibility only, post-hoc data reuse; no native T(P) reuse, runtime or general solution
